heroSummary: Cobb's year-at-a-glance calendar begins August 2 and sets aside full weeks for Fall Break, Thanksgiving Break, February Break, and Spring Holidays. Election Day is a student holiday and staff day, as are January 3 and the two weekdays after students finish May 17.
seoTitle: Cobb County School Calendar 2027-2028: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: Cobb County School District 2027-2028 calendar with first day, last day, holidays, breaks, student holiday/staff days, PDF, and ICS.
calendarNotes: Cobb County School District starts the 2027-2028 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027 and ends the student year on Wednesday, May 17, 2028. The official year-at-a-glance calendar marks Fall Break on September 20-24, Thanksgiving Break on November 22-26, Winter Break on December 20-31, Spring Holidays on April 3-7, student holiday/staff days on July 26-30, November 2, January 3, and May 18-19. The 2027-2028 PDF reviewed for this page does not list digital learning days or early release windows in its legend.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Cobb County school start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The first day of school for Cobb County School District is Monday, August 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Cobb County in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day of school is Wednesday, May 17, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When are Cobb County Spring Holidays in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Holidays run Monday, April 3 through Friday, April 7, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Winter Break for Cobb County School District in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 20 through Friday, December 31, 2027. January 3 is a student holiday/staff day.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Fall Break for Cobb County Schools in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 20 through Friday, September 24, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Cobb 2027-2028 calendar list digital learning days?
calendarFaqs.a: The reviewed 2027-2028 Cobb year-at-a-glance PDF does not include a digital learning day category in its legend.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the Cobb 2027-2028 calendar list early release days?
calendarFaqs.a: The reviewed 2027-2028 Cobb year-at-a-glance PDF does not list early release windows in its legend. Families should verify school-level and district updates before relying on dismissal times.

calendarFaqs.q: What is a student holiday/staff day on the Cobb calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: A student holiday/staff day is a no-school day for students while staff may have scheduled work, planning, or professional responsibilities.

whatsNew.title: Changes from the 2026-2027 Calendar
content: The first day moves from August 3 in 2026 to August 2 in 2027.
The last day moves from May 19 in 2027 to May 17 in 2028.
The reviewed 2027-2028 PDF does not list digital learning or early release legend categories.
Spring Holidays move from April 5-9 in 2027 to April 3-7 in 2028.
